It declares one abstract class, SessionRepository, which lists persistence operations for Session aggregates: find, create, update, updateByHash and three delete methods. It has no business rules, no transport or HTTP handling and no presentation logic. It is purely a persistence contract, and two infrastructure classes implement it (the relational and document repositories). This kind of port could arguably live in the domain or application layer.
